title: HeaderDateTime::to_timestamp doc doesn't specify behavior for pre-epoch, invalid, or out-of-range dates
close_reason: HeaderDateTime cleanup batch: (.31) tz_before_gmt bool replaced with TzSign enum (East/West); (.9) field invariants documented per field, plus type-level statement that out-of-range values yield unspecified output; (.10) wire-format dependency on mail-parser made explicit with a doc section; (.15) to_rfc3339 doc specifies exact output (Zulu Z for UTC, ±HH:MM otherwise) with examples and out-of-range escape hatch; (.16) to_timestamp doc specifies pre-epoch / out-of-range behaviour. Struct gains #[non_exhaustive]. New test pins Zulu-form output for UTC.
